name: tilttek/points-bundle
description: Points for Symfony on tilttek/points: the ledger in Doctrine DBAL, currencies and earning rules in configuration, the projection that turns members' activity into points through tilttek/activity-bundle, balances and histories, commands to expire credits and show a history, and member export and erasure

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the ledger's tables to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's points with the rest of their account
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that expire the credits due and show a member's history
suggest.tilttek/activity-bundle: To keep the journal of activity the earning rules read, and catch the points projection up live or by a command
